### GitHub Issue #4502 TypeError: entry_points() got an unexpected keyword argument 'group'
## Synopsis

TypeErrors referencing the `entry_points()` method were raised, while running Flask projects initially written for Version 2.0.1. The error does not seem to be a user-programming mistake, as the error was seen when running the Tutorial Project provided in the Flask Documentation.


## Programming Environment

The referenced Tutorial project is found in the following documentation: https://flask.palletsprojects.com/en/2.0.x/tutorial/
Minor corrections were made to the `__init__` file to mirror the Tutorial file in v2.1.0.

### Environment:
- Python version: 3.7.4
- Flask version: 2.0.1
- OS: MacOS High Sierra
